name: 雾紫滴管面部精华液款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: cloud-white #F5F3FB and mist-lilac #D9D0F0 studio fields with translucent molecular bubble motifs, deeper violet #B9A7E4 for mechanism panels and deep iris #4A3B8C for the closing panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused cool studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, low-contrast soft contact shadows, subtle violet rim glow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone vanity counter #E7E2DC and seamless studio backdrop
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line molecular and droplet icons, single violet accent
styleLock.presentationRules: upright dropper bottle as the stable hero subject, centered or rule-of-thirds, consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool lilac molecular skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-white #F5F3FB, mist-lilac #D9D0F0, deep iris purple #4A3B8C and one starlight violet accent #8E76E0; soft diffused cool studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and low-contrast soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line molecular and droplet icon style; clean high-end serum photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright dropper-bottle hero scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: panel-01 白底滴管精华瓶配紫色分子气泡主图与功效大标题；panel-02 六宫格肌肤困扰卡片（真人模特脸）；panel-03 模特侧脸配三条编号卖点丝带；panel-04 瓶身两侧成分气泡（柠檬片、绿叶）与分子链背景；panel-05 分子网络配四条编号标签；panel-06 皮肤横截使用前后示意与卡通洗脸步骤图；panel-07 步骤续图与产品信息参数表（品名、规格、保质期、成分表均作占位剥离）。品类判定：参数表品名为精华类产品，步骤图示为涂于面部，使用部位是面部而非头皮发丝，故按图判为护肤个护/面部护理而非洗护发。已剥离：品牌拼音字样、功效标题与全部原文案、模特面容与卡通人脸、会员角标与二维码贴片、规格容量与保质期数值、成分名与功效断言（一律改为 callout/selling_point 占位）；源图步骤编号错乱与成分标注互相矛盾处均未采用。
